title: Travel Completed | Delay at Arrival | Uncontrollable | APPR | Multi-Pax (2) | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Flight delayed 5 hours due to severe weather (Code 71 � snowstorm). Uncontrollable under APPR. Despite a significant delay that would normally qualify for Tier 1 ($400 per pax) if controllable, the uncontrollable weather classification blocks eligibility for all passengers on the booking. Claimant (Philippe Tremblay) has a Basic Aeroplan account linked to the booking. Validates that: (1) DDS correctly classifies Code 71 as Uncontrollable and returns NE-28 regardless of delay duration, (2) NOT ELIGIBLE result applies to all selected passengers on a multi-pax booking, (3) No payment flow is triggered even when an Aeroplan account is linked, (4) AC Wallet is NOT offered for not eligible cases regardless of Aeroplan status.
